newly_refused.reason: the reading was refused because the request asks for something to be faster or a delay to be cut, and its reading has no valid `Timeline:` assumption: it has no assumption that starts `Timeline:`; the plan would rest on the request's own figures and not on the real stage order and durations. Read the code and the recorded run timings, then add an assumption in this form: `Timeline: read <crates/ path>; stages: <name> <duration>, <name> <duration>; the delay sits in <name>.` with at least two stages in order, a duration for each such as `9 min` or `40 s` (or the words `no recorded timing`), and the stage the claimed delay sits in
